study_design: Population-based prospective cohort with 34 years of registry follow-up
cohort_total_n_excerpt: ULSAM, a population based Swedish male cohort (n = 2322) investigated at age 50 for s-Se and s-Se influencing factors: serum cholesterol, erythrocyte sedimentation rate and smoking habits.
reason: The abstract analyzes long-term incidence of prostate cancer overall. It does not report an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Smokers with s-Se in the two lower tertiles (≤80 μg/L) experienced a higher cumulative incidence of PrCa than smokers in the high selenium tertile (Hazard Ratio 2.39; 95% CI: 1.09-5.25).
estimate_classifications.reason: This is an overall prostate cancer incidence estimate. The supplied effect is the reciprocal of the abstract-reported low-versus-high selenium comparison, but inversion does not change its general endpoint classification.
